title: Release and incident communication
description: For a change or an incident that users must hear about: a named approver, a plain-language message and an outcome to measure.

rules.instruction: Ask the communication owner who approves external messages about the change, and record that person in the task.
rules.verification: Check that the task record names the approver of external messages.

rules.instruction: Draft a user-facing release note in plain language that says who is affected, what changes and what they need to do.
rules.verification: Check that the approved release note answers these three questions.

rules.instruction: Add to the incident runbook a status message template that gives the impact, the affected users and the time of the next update.
rules.verification: Open the runbook and check that the template has these three fields.

rules.instruction: Ask the communication owner which outcome, beyond the number of messages sent, shows that the communication worked, such as fewer related support tickets (Barcelona Principles 3.0).
rules.verification: Check that the communication plan records the outcome measure and its data source.
